sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Fire Release, Water Release, Broil Branch

system.description:
You coil corrosive Boil Release chakra around your arm as it forms a snake make of steam. Make two melee ninjutsu (or taijutsu) attacks dealing your [Unarmed Damage] + 2d8 Acid Damage. If the target creature has the Corroded condition, after damage calculation, they lose the Corroded condition and gain ranks of Scald equal to the rank of Corroded they currently have, as they lose the Corroded condition. (D-Rank: 1 Rank, C-Rank: 2 Ranks, B-Rank: 3 Ranks, A-Rank: 4 Ranks, S-Rank: 5 Ranks).

If both attacks are targeting the same creature, you can choose to gain +1 Pressure.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and damage by 1d8.
